purchases.title: Surviving A Life And Death Situation And Starting Bitcoin Company. Michal and Pavla Nydrle. #601
purchases.summary:
Learn how a young family of 4 survived being stranded at sea in a stricken sailboat and what they vowed to do if they survived.

$ BTC 66,822

Block Height 943,037

In this episode of the Once Bitten podcast, I interview Michal and Pavla Nydrle, the family team behind Inviti, a European-based Bitcoin app, about their journey into Bitcoin and their near-death experience at sea that motivated them to make a difference in the world through Bitcoin education and accessibility.

Key Topics:

- Introduction to Michal and Pavla Nydrle
- The Sailing Trip and Near-Death Experience
- Political Involveme
